title: Staff Software Engineer - CTV (Ad Server)
description:
**About The Role**
PubMatic is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help architect and evolve our next-generation, highly scalable, low-latency AdServer for Connected TV (CTV) – operating at a scale of 1 trillion+ requests per day and managing millions of requests per second. This is a technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to shape the architectural direction of the CTV AdServer platform, not just one team’s roadmap, in one of the fastest-growing areas of programmatic advertising. If you thrive on solving distributed-systems problems at extreme scale, enjoy influencing engineering direction across multiple teams, and want to be one of the most senior technical voices in the organization, we’d love to talk to you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Product & Architecture Influence: Influence multiple teams across the AdServer organization by defining and reviewing product and platform architecture and implementations. Identify architectural risks early and propose alternatives and solutions that hold up at trillion-scale.
* Architectural Oversight: Oversee the design and implementation of critical platform components by maintaining in-depth knowledge of best practices, technologies, architectures, and emerging technologies, and by setting the technical bar for the AdServer engineering organization.
* Standards & Decisions: Document and communicate exceptions to architectural standards by capturing significant architectural decisions (ADRs), ensuring decisions and their rationale are visible, durable, and reusable across teams.
* Own end-to-end technical direction for the AdServer platform – partnering with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, Engineering Leads, and Product Leads to translate business needs into a coherent, multi-quarter technical roadmap.
* Lead the design and evolution of highly reliable, scalable, low-latency distributed backend platforms and services, and set the technical direction that other teams build on.
* Drive research into emerging technologies, sponsor proof-of-concepts, and make build/adopt decisions that materially move the platform forward.
* Act as a technical escalation point across teams – auditing designs for platform stability, reviewing major architecture changes across the AdServer Development Team, and unblocking the hardest cross-cutting problems.
* Partner with Data Center and DevOps teams on long-range technical planning – new technology adoption, software optimization strategy, and stability roadmaps for the overall platform.
* Mentor and raise the technical bar of Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, and other senior ICs, through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands-on technical guidance.
* Champion engineering best practices and documentation standards across teams; ensure designs meet requirements and that platform-wide work meets a consistently high quality bar.
* Drive the application of GenAI across the software development lifecycle – design, coding, testing, and documentation – and help set the standard for AI-enabled engineering across the org.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* 14+ years of hands-on development experience in C/C++ in a Linux/UNIX environment, with a track record of shipping and evolving large-scale distributed systems. Experience with Go is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams or a full platform, not just a single service or team.
* Deep proficiency in algorithms and advanced data structures, with a strong foundation in core computer science principles.
* Extensive experience in software design and architecture for complex, scalable, low-latency, high-throughput systems.
* A track record of identifying architectural risk ahead of time and driving alternatives that are adopted broadly.
* Ability to write and review architectural decision records, and to communicate trade-offs clearly to both engineering and product stakeholders.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to find optimal, innovative solutions to open-ended technical problems.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI-based tools and IDEs to accelerate development; comfort with prompt engineering fundamentals and an understanding of different model types at a working level.
* Deep knowledge of OS internals and systems programming – multi-threading, multi-processing, and memory management – and the ability to troubleshoot the hardest production issues.
* Ability to write clean, modular, loosely coupled code, and to hold others to that same bar through review.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of product functionality across the platform, not just an individual component.
* Working knowledge of scripting (Perl/Python/Shell) and databases (preferably MySQL).
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority.

**Good To Have - CTV Domain Experience**

* Prior hands-on experience building or scaling ad serving, ad decisioning, or real-time bidding systems specifically for Connected TV (CTV) / OTT.
* Working knowledge of CTV-specific technical protocols and standards – e.g. VAST/VPAID/VMAP, SSAI (server-side ad insertion) and CSAI, HLS/DASH manifest manipulation, and IAB CTV/OTT specifications.
* Understanding of the CTV supply chain and its unique constraints – device- and app-level identifiers (e.g. IFA, RIDA), frequency capping and pod/ad-break management, content-level targeting, and the latency/quality bar required for a living-room viewing experience.
* Familiarity with SSAI stitching architectures and the trade-offs between client-side and server-side ad insertion at scale.
* Exposure to OTT/streaming platforms, smart TV operating systems (e.g. Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS), or set-top box environments, and the constraints they place on ad delivery.
* Understanding of CTV measurement, viewability, and completion-rate reporting requirements, and how they differ from traditional display/video.
* Awareness of the evolving CTV privacy and identity landscape (e.g. data clean rooms, alternative identifiers, cross-device graphs) and its implications for ad server architecture.

**AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset**
We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high-scale, performance-critical environment.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Arista's cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network — using protocols like 802.1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI — and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time.
  
  
The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function — not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product.
  
  
You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features — authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding — primarily in Go.
* Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e.g., RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves.
* Build and extend internal test utility libraries — simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers — and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test.
* Drive root-cause analysis on test failures — distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it.
* Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented — shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end.
* Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers.
* Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue.
* Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the team's test framework.
* Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews — identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field.
* 3–6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering — not just manual testing.
* Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis.
* Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols — 802.1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong.
* Hands-on experience with REST API testing — designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code.
* Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) — writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability.
* Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication — test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS).
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) — knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior.
* Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios.
* Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) — validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

title: Elastic Engineer
description:
**Elastic Engineer — Job Description (Multiple Openings)**
Roles available
  
  
We are hiring for four roles across our Elastic Engineering and Elastic Operations teams. All candidates are assessed against one common set of requirements. Your experience and interview performance decide which role you are offered.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad. Operations roles are work-from-office on 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Role Team Level Total experience Relevant Elastic experience Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Junior 2–4 yrs 2 yrs min Senior Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Senior (L2-capable) 8–12 yrs 4–6 yrs min Elastic Operations Engineer Elastic Operations L1 2–4 yrs 1–2 yrs min Elastic Operations Lead Elastic Operations L2 / Lead 6–10 yrs 3–4 yrs min
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build, run and scale Elastic/Observability platforms for a large enterprise SIEM programme. Our estate covers self-managed and self-hosted Elastic clusters on AWS (EC2 and EKS) and Azure, ingesting security and observability data at enterprise scale.
  
  

* Elastic Engineering designs, automates, onboards data and upgrades the platform.
* Elastic Operations keeps it healthy and stable around the clock, handles tickets and incidents, and drives RCAs.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Scope and depth grow with level. Junior and L1 roles execute; Senior and Lead roles design, own and lead.
  
  
Platform engineering
  
  

* Install, configure, size and maintain ELK clusters (self-managed and self-hosted): node roles, data tiers, ILM, snapshots, CCR/CCS
* Deploy and operate Elastic on EKS (ECK or Helm)
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, from manual rolling upgrades to fully automated upgrades with pre-checks and rollback
* Onboard data sources through Fleet, Elastic Agent and integrations, Beats, Logstash and OpenTelemetry
* Build Logstash pipelines and ingest pipelines for parsing, enrichment and ECS normalisation
* Set up APM and OpenTelemetry agents and collectors
* Configure anomaly detection jobs, Kibana spaces, RBAC and role mappings
* Build dashboards in Kibana and Grafana

Automation and cloud
  
  

* Automate platform tasks in Python against Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs
* Build CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure with Terraform
* Design AWS log collection and connectivity: VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect

Operations and support
  
  

* Monitor cluster health, ingestion and capacity; perform routine maintenance
* Handle tickets within SLA; triage and resolve issues at L1, escalate or resolve at L2
* Join and lead incident bridges, including Sev1 calls; manage escalations
* Write RCAs and runbooks; track corrective actions to closure
* Senior and Lead roles: mentor engineers, review designs and code, manage shift rosters and report operational KPIs

Requirements in detail
  
  
Candidates should cover most of the areas below. The depth expected rises with the role.
  
  
Elastic Stack core
  
  

* ELK setup and administration on self-managed and self-hosted clusters
* Cluster troubleshooting: unassigned shards, heap and disk pressure, circuit breakers, slow queries, node failures and recovery
* Elasticsearch APIs (\\_cat, \\_cluster, \\_nodes, index and ILM APIs, Query DSL) and Kibana APIs
* KQL, with working knowledge of ES|QL
* Index design, mappings, templates, ILM and data tiers (hot, warm, cold, frozen)
* Cluster upgrades: planning, pre-checks, rolling upgrade, validation and rollback

Data onboarding and parsing
  
  

* Fleet, Elastic Agent and its integrations
* Logstash: pipeline configuration, filters, persistent queues and tuning
* Ingest pipelines and data parsing (grok, dissect, processors, ECS mapping)

Observability
  
  

* APM setup and configuration
* OpenTelemetry agent and collector setup
* Dashboarding in Kibana and Grafana
* Anomaly detection (machine learning) jobs

Access and security
  
  

* Kibana spaces, RBAC, roles and role mapping (SAML, LDAP, AD)
* TLS and certificate management for the stack

Cloud, containers and networking
  
  

* AWS basics (EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) and Azure basics
* VPC concepts: subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs
* Network connectivity options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, load balancers
* EKS and Kubernetes operations, including ECK
* Senior level: AWS architecture in depth, including VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail and cross-account logging

Automation and DevOps (Senior Engineer and Operations Lead)
  
  

* Hands-on Python for automation against Elastic APIs
* CI/CD setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Terraform and infrastructure as code; Git-based workflows
* A track record of automations delivered, e.g. upgrade automation, onboarding automation, health-check scripts

Operations practice (Operations roles; valued for all)
  
  

* Ticket handling within SLA in ServiceNow, Jira or similar
* Incident calls, Sev1 triage and escalation handling
* RCA findings and write-ups; runbook and knowledge-base upkeep
* ITIL incident, problem and change processes
* Willingness to work 24×7 rotational shifts from office

Good to have
  
  

* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Observability Engineer
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional); HashiCorp Terraform Associate; ITIL v4 Foundation
* Exposure to Elastic Security (SIEM) and detection rules
* Azure log sources and networking (Event Hub, Azure Monitor)
* Linux administration and shell scripting

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
* Clear written and spoken communication for tickets, RCAs and stakeholder updates

title: Platform Security Engineer
description:

The
**C11 Platform Security Engineer**
contributes to the end-to-end design, development, and enhancement of high-throughput Java microservices and reverse-proxy components within the Security Gatewayecosystem. Working closely with C12 Lead Engineers and cross-functional teams, the role focuses on building secure, scalable, and resilient security filtering and API routing components.

* Secure Coding & Vulnerability Remediation: Ensure all developed code complies with enterprise security benchmarks (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx, MCD scans) and remediate identified vulnerabilities promptly.

* 5–8 years of hands-on software development experience with enterprise Java applications.

* Working knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and SAML.
* Practical experience working with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift).
* Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, SQL querying, and database connection pooling.
* Hands-on experience with automated testing tools (JUnit, Mockito) and CI/CD tools (Git, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins/Tekton).
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with distributed systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical issues clearly in an Agile team setup.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

We are seeking an experienced and visionary
**Java Technical Lead (C12)**
to join our Enterprise Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and architectural evolution of high-throughput, mission-critical enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional architecture, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed event-driven platforms.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a C12 Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical execution with engineering leadership. You will drive architectural decisions, govern development standards, mentor engineering talent, and deliver end-to-end resilient back-end and distributed messaging solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, modern DevOps practices, and cloud-native containerized delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Lead the technical design, system decomposition, and development of mission-critical microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with organizational blueprints, compliance benchmarks, and engineering standards.
* Own technical governance, including architectural reviews, coding standards, automated testing frameworks, and non-functional requirements (resilience, scalability, low latency, fault tolerance).

Hands-on Engineering & Delivery
  
  

* Design and implement robust, high-performance back-end services using Core Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs.
* Build and optimize event streaming and message-oriented middleware patterns using Apache Kafka and IBM MQ / JMS.
* Architect and tune high-volume data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL document stores (MongoDB).
* Drive containerization and deployment strategies targeting modern enterprise cloud platforms (ECS / Red Hat OpenShift).

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship
  
  

* Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce unit/integration test coverage standards, and eliminate technical debt.
* Mentor and coach junior and mid-level developers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks.

Agile & DevOps Collaboration
  
  

* Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Business Stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum delivery model to translate complex business requirements into clear technical roadmaps and epics.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity.

**Primary (Core) Skills & Competencies**

* Core Java & Frameworks: Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning.
* Spring Ecosystem: Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* API & Integration: Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns.
* Messaging & Event Streaming: Strong hands-on implementation experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, fault handling) and enterprise message queues (IBM MQ / JMS).
* Database Engineering: Relational: Oracle DB (complex SQL, PL/SQL, schema design, index tuning, transaction isolation). NoSQL: MongoDB (data modeling, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning).
* Design Patterns & Clean Code: Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns.

Secondary Skills & Familiarity (Highly Desirable)
  
  

* Containerization & Platforms: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms such as ECS / Red Hat OpenShift.
* Frontend / Full-Stack Exposure: Familiarity with modern frontend development using Angular, React JS.
* Business Process Management: Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM.
* Application Servers & Middleware: Understanding of legacy or hybrid runtime environments including IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS / Liberty).
* CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk).

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills with a proven track record of resolving complex distributed systems challenges.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to non-technical business partners.
* Ownership & Drive: Demonstrated ability to independently lead engineering initiatives from ideation to production rollout.
* Collaboration: High team spirit and emotional intelligence to work across globally distributed engineering teams.
